title: Valve summary rounding tie on 1079654 (ex-Zero Tenacity vs ex-RUSTEC) resolved via official per-roster detail files
detail: Valve's summary markdown standings_global_2026_10_05.md prints integer-rounded 1066 points for both #92 ex-RUSTEC and #93 ex-Zero Tenacity, leaving 50.0%/50.0% without a side. Valve's linked official per-roster detail files in the same commit publish Git-SHA1-verified unrounded Final Rank Values: #92 ex-RUSTEC = 1066.4 vs #93 ex-Zero Tenacity = 1065.6 (49.9% vs 50.1%, fair lines 2.004 / 1.996). Flagged for transparency because the 0.8-point VRS margin is near-coinflip and HLTV's weekly ranking reverses the order (#67 ex-Zero Tenacity vs #70 ex-RUSTEC).

title: Provider start-time disagreements held out on 1082882 (UNiTY vs Apogee Betclic) and 1082769 (K27 vs NEXORA)
detail: On fixture 1082882 (HLTV 2399784 and Hotspawn start 2026-10-22T14:00:00Z), Polymarket (1231280), Thunderpick (2865424), and Bovada (32573371) agree on 14:00:00Z and produce the multi-source money line, while Kalshi contract KXCS2GAME-26OCT221230APOGEEUNITY lists 16:30:00Z and stays excluded under the ±60s rule. On fixture 1082769 (HLTV 2399846 and Hotspawn start 2026-10-22T17:30:00Z), Bovada (32593732) and Kalshi (KXCS2GAME-26OCT221200NEXK27) list 16:00:00Z and stay excluded; the fixture uses the hash-verified EGamersWorld bookmaker average at the matching 17:30:00Z start.

title: Four EGamersWorld match pages print default 1.8 / 1.8 placeholders and are explicitly rejected
detail: Audited individual EGamersWorld match pages for 1079654 (ex-Zero Tenacity vs ex-RUSTEC), 1081596 (Falcons Force vs Phantom Academy), 1082882 (UNiTY vs Apogee Betclic), and 1081148 (Inner Circle Academy vs Spirit Academy). All four match pages display identical 1.8 / 1.8 banner odds and no published bookmaker-average sentence, even where the listing index showed non-equal numbers (1.58/2.15 on 1081596, 1.86/1.8 on 1081148). Recorded under rejected in data/research/a34bc06b/reference-odds.json so no placeholder ever enters consensus.

title: Network-model provenance label corrected on /origination/ and logged for scripts/originate.py
detail: Four academy/low-tier fixtures (1081596, 1081148, 1082210, 1082861) are estimated by scripts/network_model.py over finished bo3.gg CS2 series (family='network'), yet scripts/originate.py set o['label'] to 'Research model estimate (Valve official ratings)'. Fixed rendering in scripts/build_origination.py to print 'Own network estimate (bo3.gg finished-series graph)' and logged the exact two-line follow-up in COORDINATION.md for the active scripts/originate.py owners.
